title.ko: 환경 어휘 · 원인과 해결책 · 조건문과 수동태 · 제안
title.en: environmental vocabulary · causes and solutions · conditionals and passives · proposals

explain.ko: 환경에 관한 글에서는 문제의 원인, 결과, 해결책을 순서대로 다룹니다. 원인은 because of, due to, as a result of, lead to로, 결과는 consequently, as a result로 연결합니다. 해결책은 should, must, need to 같은 조동사와 수동태(Plastic should be recycled)로 쓰면 객관적입니다. 가정은 조건문(If the government supported …, emissions would fall)으로 표현합니다. 어휘는 climate change, greenhouse gas, renewable energy, sustainable, pollution, carbon footprint을 익혀 둡니다.
explain.en: Texts on the environment present causes, effects and solutions in order. Link causes with because of, due to, as a result of, lead to; effects with consequently, as a result. Solutions with should, must, need to and passives (Plastic should be recycled) sound objective. Hypotheses use conditionals (If the government supported …, emissions would fall). Learn climate change, greenhouse gas, renewable energy, sustainable, pollution and carbon footprint.

items.passage:
ARTICLE
A city has banned single-use plastic from this year. At first citizens found it inconvenient but soon adapted. The city authorities announced that waste had fallen by 30%. Other cities are considering the same policy.

trans.ko:
기사
한 도시는 올해부터 일회용 플라스틱 사용을 금지했다. 시민들은 처음에는 불편했지만 곧 적응했다. 시 당국은 쓰레기가 30% 줄었다고 발표했다. 다른 도시들도 같은 정책을 검토하고 있다.

prompt.ko: 환경 문제의 원인과 해결책을 4문장으로 써 보세요. 수동태와 조건문을 하나씩 쓰세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences about the causes of and solutions to an environmental problem, using a passive and a conditional.

task.model: Greenhouse gas emissions are the main cause of climate change. Waste such as plastic should be recycled. If the government supported renewable energy more, emissions would fall greatly. Our small actions can also make a big difference.

model_trans.ko: 온실가스 배출은 기후 변화의 주요 원인입니다. 플라스틱과 같은 쓰레기는 재활용해야 합니다. 정부가 재생 에너지를 더 지원한다면 배출량은 크게 줄 것입니다. 우리의 작은 실천도 큰 변화를 만들 수 있습니다.
model_trans.en: Greenhouse gas emissions are the main cause of climate change. Waste such as plastic should be recycled. If the government supported renewable energy more, emissions would fall greatly. Our small actions can also make a big difference.
